features.name: normalized_decile_score
features.description: COMPAS recidivism decile score normalized to [0,1] range for smooth linear margin separation
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear projection of COMPAS risk assessment onto SVM margin

features.name: normalized_violence_score
features.description: COMPAS violence decile score normalized to [0,1] range
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures violent recidivism risk as continuous feature for linear separation

features.name: composite_risk_score
features.description: Weighted composite of recidivism and violence decile scores, with recidivism weighted higher
features.expected_model_benefit: Single smooth composite risk signal combining both COMPAS dimensions for linear SVM

features.name: log_priors_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed prior offense count normalized by training set max, reducing skew for linear models
features.expected_model_benefit: Smoothed prior offense signal with reduced outlier influence for linear SVM margin

features.name: juvenile_offense_severity
features.description: Weighted sum of juvenile offense counts with felonies weighted highest, normalized by training max
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures juvenile criminal history severity as continuous feature for linear separation

features.name: age_risk_inverse
features.description: Inverse age-based risk score where younger individuals have higher scores, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures age-related recidivism pattern as smooth continuous feature for linear SVM

features.name: charge_severity_score
features.description: Numeric encoding of charge degree severity mapped to continuous scale, higher values indicate more severe charges
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous charge severity signal for linear SVM margin computation

features.name: risk_age_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized COMPAS score and inverse age risk, capturing young high-risk individuals
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nonlinear interaction between age and risk score as linear feature for SVM

features.name: priors_age_ratio
features.description: Ratio of log prior counts to age, capturing offense rate relative to life experience
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized offense rate per year of life as smooth linear feature

features.name: score_text_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of COMPAS score text category (Low=0, Medium=0.5, High=1) as continuous feature
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ordinal risk category encoding for linear SVM boundary

features.name: total_criminal_history_score
features.description: Combined criminal history score integrating priors and juvenile offenses with log smoothing
features.expected_model_benefit: Comprehensive criminal history signal as single normalized feature for linear SVM

features.name: risk_score_divergence
features.description: Semantic assessment of divergence between recidivism and violence risk scores; high divergence may indicate specialized risk profile. Score 0 means scores are aligned, 1 means maximum divergence between the two COMPAS dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cases where recidivism and violence risk profiles diverge, providing additional discriminative signal for linear SVM
